new.story: A 1954 Argentine 5 centavos from the Peron era. The value side reads REPUBLICA ARGENTINA around a big 5; the other side carries Jose de San Martin, the liberator. Copper-nickel over steel — Argentina was economizing on metal in the 1950s.
new.notes: Blind double-read. Legend read character by character from enlargement: REPUBLICA ARGENTINA / 5 / CENTAVOS / 1954. Denomination and date printed on coin; no measurement needed.
